x-code-samples.source:
<?php

$request = new HttpRequest();
$request->setUrl('https://apis-sandbox.fedex.com/commodity/v2/hscodes/search');
$request->setMethod(HTTP_METH_POST);

$request->setHeaders(array(
  'Authorization' => 'Bearer ',
  'X-locale' => 'en_US',
  'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
));

$request->setBody(input); // 'input' refers to JSON Payload

try {
  $response = $request->send();

  echo $response->getBody();
} catch (HttpException $ex) {
  echo $ex;
}

import requests

url = "https://apis-sandbox.fedex.com/commodity/v2/hscodes/search"

payload = input # 'input' refers to JSON Payload
headers = {
    'Content-Type': "application/json",
    'X-locale': "en_US",
    'Authorization': "Bearer "
    }

response = requests.post(url, data=payload, headers=headers)

print(response.text)

HarmonizedCodeSearchRequestVO.description: These are the harmonized code search request details.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID is a special set of numbers that defines each transaction.

customerTransactionId.description: This element allows you to assign a unique identifier to your transaction. This element is also returned in the reply and helps you match the request to the reply

HarmonizedCodeSearchResponseVO.description: These are the harmonized code search response details.

commodityDescription.description: Commodity description that would describe the commodity.
commodityDescription.example: Footwear with outer soles of rubber or plastics: Sports footwear;

destinationCountryCodes.description: List of destination country codes for the classification. Either originCountryCode or destinationCountryCodes is mandatory

originCountryCode.description: The country of origin code for the commodity.  Either originCountryCode or destinationCountryCodes is mandatory

countryOfManufacture.description: The country code where the commodity was manufactured.

categories.description: List of categories associated with the commodity.

material.description: The material composition of the commodity for classification. e.g., plastic, wood, steel

HsClassifyVO.description: These are the details required to classify a commodity for a harmonized code search.

hsClassifications.description: Indicates the Harmonized system search summaries.

HarmonizedCodeOutputVO.description: These are all the harmonized search response details.

countryCode.description: The ISO country code associated with this classification.

countryType.description:
Specifies if the country is the origin or the destination.
Valid values: DESTINATION, ORIGIN

SummaryVO.description: Summary information for a specific harmonized code search result.

description.description: Description of the commodity associated with this alternative code.
description.example: Footwear with outer soles of rubber, plastics, leather or composition leather and uppers of leather: Other footwear: Other: Other: Footwear with a vamp made of straps or which has one or several pieces cut out: Other, with insoles of a length: Of less than 24 cm

confidenceScore.description: The numerical score indicating the system's confidence in this specific classification.

SubheadingAlternatesVO.description: An Subheading classification option provided by the system.

description.description: Description of the commodity associated with this alternative code.
description.example: Footwear with outer soles of rubber, plastics, leather or composition leather and uppers of leather: Other footwear: Other: Other: Footwear with a vamp made of straps or which has one or several pieces cut out: Other, with insoles of a length: Of less than 24 cm

TarriffAlternatesVO.description: An Tarriff alternative classification option provided by the system.

amount.description: The numeric value of the unit price.

currency.description: The currency code associated with the price (e.g., USD).

UnitPriceVO.description: Represents the monetary value per unit of the commodity.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID is a special set of numbers that defines each transaction.

customerTransactionId.description:
This element allows you to assign a unique identifier to your transaction. This element is also returned in the reply and helps you match the request to the reply.
Example: AnyCo_order123456789
